یادگیری انگلیسی،\nبا محتوای کلاس خودت:
Learn English
with your class content
ریکالینو یک فضای شخصی یادگیری انگلیسی بر: Recalino is a personal English learning workspace for adults aged 18 and over. It keeps each class’s materials together and turns them into notes and practice. The current MVP centres on the learner’s own class content.

صدای کلاس، جزوه و عکس تخته باید دوباره ک: Recordings, notes and board photos need to come together after class.
زبان‌آموز به یک مسیر روشن برای انتخاب و: Learners need a clear way to choose and practise the points that matter.
این‌ها مسئله‌ها و فرض‌های طراحی در سند م: The initial audience is adult English learners who want relevant practice after class. Recalino addresses the friction of scattered materials and limited review time. These are product design hypotheses. The project has not yet established them through market research or measured learner outcomes.

چرخهٔ اصلی چهار مرحله دارد. کاربر منابع: The learner adds class sources, reads notes with source references, and chooses or edits cards for daily practice. The live review flow uses FSRS to schedule cards according to recall responses. The preview demonstrates the interaction without calculating a real review schedule.

نمای رابط با دادهٔ نمونه؛ ضبط در این پیش: Sample interface. Recording is simulated in this preview.
بک‌اند نسخهٔ اولیه برای ضبط مرورگر با مک: The MVP supports browser recording with pause and resume, local recovery, and uploads of audio, images, PDFs and text. Learners can review sources and quota use before processing. The preview simulates recording and does not activate the microphone. Real recording requires the permission of people present. Long recording tests on target devices remain incomplete.

بخشی از جزوهٔ نمونهٔ Present perfect: Excerpt from the sample Present perfect notes
جزوه از مدل دانشی ساخت‌یافته ساخته می‌شو: Recalino builds notes from a structured knowledge model and records the origin of each content section. Editing creates a new version, which the learner can compare with earlier versions. Regeneration offers proposed changes and preserves the learner’s edits until they choose to accept a replacement. The examples shown here use synthetic content.
منبع هر نکته روشن است: A clear source for every point
ارجاع به زمان صوت یا صفحهٔ سند: Links to audio timestamps or document pages
توضیح تکمیلی با منشأ مشخص: Extra context with a clear origin
نمای منبعِ جزوه در فضای نمونه: Source reference view in the preview
تمایز میان محتوای کلاس، توضیح افزودهٔ AI: Recalino distinguishes class content from additional AI explanation and the learner’s own edits. Points attributed to the class need valid source references, such as an audio timestamp or document page. These references help the learner check a point against the source. They do not guarantee educational accuracy.

شش نوع کارت در schema واقعی تعریف شده‌ان: The MVP supports question and answer, vocabulary, cloze, grammar, error correction and listening cards. Learners review the suggested cards and can choose or edit them before adding them to practice. The listening example uses computer-generated speech. AI-generated images are outside the MVP scope.

پاسخ را مقایسه می‌کنی و نتیجهٔ یادآوری ر: Compare your answer and record how well you recalled it. FSRS schedules the next review.
مرور کوتاه با هدف زمانی قابل تنظیم: Short sessions with a flexible time goal
نمای جلسهٔ نمونه؛ زمان‌بندی واقعی در پیش: Sample review session. Real scheduling is disabled in the preview.
The live review flow uses FSRS. Learners recall the answer before revealing it, then record their response so the scheduler can choose the next review time. The interface supports Simple and Advanced modes, undoing the latest response, and a time goal. The preview’s Forgot and Remembered controls demonstrate the interaction without changing a real account’s schedule.

رابط اصلی نسخهٔ اولیه انگلیسی است. زبان: The MVP’s main interface is English. Learners can choose English or their first language for explanations, while class vocabulary and examples stay in English. First-language explanations carry an Experimental label because their quality still needs evaluation. The learner chooses their level. It does not represent a placement test result.

بخش خروجی HTML در فضای نمونه: HTML export view in the preview
خروجی HTML مستقل و خروجی APKG در بک‌اند: The MVP provides standalone HTML notes and APKG card exports. HTML notes can be read in a browser without connecting to Recalino. Synthetic APKG data has passed an Anki import test, including a repeat import without duplicates. The preview does not connect to the real APKG exporter. Anki synchronisation, importing from Anki, and fully offline review remain outside the MVP scope.
کنترل روشن روی منابع و داده‌ها: Control over your sources and data
فقط جداکردن از کلاس، حذف فایل اصلی یا حذ:
Detach a source, remove the original file,
or delete its linked content.
نسخهٔ سرور برای رونویسی است و حداکثر ۲۴:
The server copy supports transcription.
It is deleted within 24 hours after a
successful transcription.
این اسلاید رفتار مصوب و پیاده‌سازی‌شدهٔ: Sources are private. The original recording stays on the learner’s device, and the server keeps a transcription copy for no more than 24 hours after successful transcription. Deletion controls distinguish removing a source from a class, deleting its file, and deleting linked content. Legal text and the data processing agreement still need approval before a pilot with real class content. The project has no independent security or compliance certification.

آزمون‌های AI و نمونه‌های این ارائه از دا: AI tests and the examples in this deck use synthetic data.
بر اساس گزارش تکمیل MVP در ۴ اکتبر ۲۰۲۶،: As of 4 October 2026, the project reports the main MVP features as implemented and checked with automated tests and synthetic data. The next stage is a controlled learner pilot, human evaluation of educational quality, and completion of legal and data approvals. Synthetic examples do not establish learning outcomes or retention rates. Real class processing still depends on the relevant approvals.
فضایی برای یادگیری با محتوای خودت: English practice built around your content
برای ادامهٔ معرفی، فضای نمونه را باز کنی: The preview walks through Today, Class, Notes, Cards and Review with synthetic content. It demonstrates the interface without changing a real learner’s review schedule. The mobile view also uses sample data. Access to the preview may depend on deployment protection.
